text: For me it comes down to habit [R1]. I already buy [C1] every week, so a new can only has to taste as good and sit at a similar price. The relaxation angle is a bonus, not the reason. I would try it because it fits what I already do.

I hear that, but my budget decides [R1]. A can I pay extra for has to beat [C2] on taste, not just on the label. If it shows up on a student deal I will try it, otherwise I stick with what I know works.
